title: Moldai
body:
"Expired 8/18/23. Alternate reality? True meaning?"

Description

Moldai is an item sold at River Shop for 30 Credits. It's a 4th added variant of Moai and serves no purpose other than decoration.

Appearance

Moldai is a Moai covered in green mold, similar in texture to Mythril.

Due to being of similar nature, Moldai uses the same mesh as other Moais, made by InvertedReality.

Trivia

  • 8/18/23 is the date of Map Revamp update.
  • Mention of "Alternate reality" might imply that current events of the new map are happening in an alternate reality, and not in the past, like community likes to speculate.
